text:
jess: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortem — we're seeing recurring OOMs in shard pool B when prefix-heavy traffic spikes. Need owners and short timeline for actions.

omar: I'm happy to own short-term mitigations. Suggest we add a soft limit per-shard and a lightweight eviction policy while we root-cause.

kyle: +1. Also want to run jemalloc + pprof captures across an offending instance for the next 3 spikes. Can automate with a tiny script.

ravi: Can we get heap profiles to include KV cache hot prefixes? We should correlate with request histograms (seq len, model id).

jess: Plan proposal: (1) soft_limit per-shard (2) enable per-shard LRU eviction with TTL=30m (3) gather pprof + jemalloc stats for 48h. Owners: @omar for (1,2), @kyle for (3). Timeline: soft limits in 48h, eviction in 72h, profiling 48-96h.

anita: For eviction, let's do a canary in us-west-2 only first to measure tail-latency impact. I'd rather not change global policy before canary.

omar: Agreed. Canary target: 10% of shard pool B traffic routed to new policy. Rollout plan: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 6h increments if no regresses.

kyle: Script snippet I'll use for pprof collection:```bash
# run on instance
curl -sS http://localhost:9090/debug/pprof/heap > /tmp/heap-$(date +%s).pb
jeprof --text /usr/local/bin/service /tmp/heap-*.pb | head -n 200 > /tmp/jeprof-summary.txt
```

ravi: Also capture slab stats: `je_malloc_stats_print(NULL, NULL, NULL)` or call runtime endpoint /debug/jemalloc. Add to cron for 5m interval during profiling window.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: Canary assignment created: route=shard-B-canary, capacity=10%, owner=omar, created_by=jess, id=canary-2148429012.

anita: kpi we care about during canary: 95p latency tail, token/s throughput, OOM occurrences, and cache hit rate. Add dashboards: /dashboards/shard-b/canary -> please add these metrics.

omar: I'll open a minimal PR to add soft_limit env override and per-shard eviction toggle. Will include rollout annotations and a migration rollback flag. Targeting PR by EOD.

jess: Great. kyle — can you attach an initial checklist in this thread once scripts are up? We want step-by-step for oncall during rollout.

kyle: Will do. Checklist preview: 1) deploy canary 10% 2) monitor for 15m 3) if OOM or >2x error rate, rollback to 0% 4) collect profiles and upload to /s3/oom-profiles/2148429012/ 5) escalate if not resolved in 2h.

ravi: One more ask: enable jemalloc decay tweaks on canary nodes: `MALLOC_CONF=decay_time:1,lg_dirty_mult:16` — should help fragmentation. Put behind env toggle.

omar: noted. I'll include env toggle in the PR.

anita: Who's owner for long-term remediation? We need a single tracking ticket for GC/allocator work, slab tuning, and KV internal refactor.

jess: I'll create a GH issue after the canary. Provisional long-term owners: ravi (profiling/allocator), kyle (observable/collection), omar (runtime eviction + policy).

sre-bot: reminder: incident follow-up template: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/template - add remediation ticket link before closing.

kyle: Putting the initial profile job live now. Will ping here with the /s3 path once first dump completes.

jess: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene in this thread after the first 24h of profiling. If anyone hits blockers, @here. :thumbsup:
